qualification.unknown_protocol: unverified; require explicit future adapter/source binding; legacy v5 pins do not constrain product development

material_identity.retrieval_corpus_fixture_seeding: Allowed only as explicit synthetic retrieval-engine corpus in later authorized isolated job; not model learning proof.
material_identity.belief_or_growth_fixture_acceptance: Forbidden: evaluated beliefs/adaptation/tool completions need actual model/runtime/independent receipts.

independent_review.human_review_default: No additional model call. Any independent-model review must have separate explicit named accounting under the same original project budget/call rules.

privacy.capture_only: Parsed synthetic outputs, actual selected case material, policy/commit/denial receipts and fee projections

budget.final_ledger_only: Do not sum cumulative snapshots; unique reservation IDs, unknown usage never zero.
budget.insufficient_budget: wait/error honestly; no shorter task, truncated counterevidence or automatic paid retry
budget.clock: real calendar; no timestamp writes for behavior or fourteen-day evidence

growth_controls.A_excludes_training_and_all_derivatives: Include recency, current stances, summaries and provider session history; not just long-term memory search.

formal_gates.retrieval_source_time_scope_errors: reported separately; recall cannot mask them

fourteen_real_days.downtime: report honestly, never count as lived activity

limitations: Material validation cannot certify semantic label quality or runtime behavior.
Standalone evaluation computes declared-evidence metrics only; formal acceptance remains unverified until qualified M5 collection and independent review.
No current DB/model adapter is invented for evolving autobiography/emotion/development schemas.
